init_hook: echo "ansible: $(ansible --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -oP '\d+\.\d+\.\d+')  tofu: $(tofu --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -oP '\d+\.\d+\.\d+')  packer: $(packer --version 2>/dev/null)"
echo 'Run `devbox run help` for available commands'

help: echo '  ansible:setup-monitoring  Deploy monitoring stack (limit with -l IP)'
echo '  ansible:register-vm       Register a VM with alloy (limit with -l IP)'
echo '  ansible:unregister-vm     Remove alloy from a VM (limit with -l IP)'
echo '  packer:build-clone        Build VM from existing template'
echo '  packer:build-iso          Build VM from ISO'
packer:build-clone: cd "02 - provisioning/01 - Packer/Clone" && packer init . && packer build .
packer:build-iso: cd "02 - provisioning/01 - Packer/ISO" && packer init . && packer build .
